text: Culdcept is back after ten years, and there's a free demo.
It's Monopoly, but every square is a fight.
Roll the dice, claim land, and defend it with creature cards when someone lands on you.
There are over four hundred cards, all with new art.
Best part: attacks burst right out of the cards, like a salamander breathing fire.
The catch? The battle health bars look plain next to all that art.
The demo is about two and a half gigs, in five languages.
Think Monopoly meets Magic: The Gathering.
Worth a dip if you like your luck with some strategy.
